# Rationale

Rationale is aimed at writers and researchers, with serif body text, a clean hierarchy and monochrome icons meant to reduce distraction. Four light and dark color schemes are offered, alongside reworked callouts, extended checkbox states, justified text, a focus mode and card layouts for dataview.

![Rationale screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davidszp/obsidian-rationale/HEAD/assets/rationale-light-thumb.png)

```cue

    name:   "Rationale"
    author: "davidszp"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
```
